hero.tagline: Product-minded full stack engineer with end-to-end ownership — from architecture to production across React / TypeScript and Python / Node.

about.lead: I take ideas all the way to production —
about.emphasis: and own every layer in between.
about.p1: I'm a full-stack engineer who does his best work at the intersection of product and engineering — where good UX meets clean, scalable code. I care about the details that never show up in a demo but decide whether a product holds up in production, and about the metrics that move a business rather than the ones that just look good in a commit.
about.p2: Right now I'm at Carbon Free Brasil, where I led the migration of a legacy PHP monolith to modular FastAPI services and built the serverless pipelines behind real-time GHG calculations for 200+ enterprise clients — John Deere, Heineken, Coca-Cola, McDonald's. Before that I shipped financial tooling at a $4B+ wealth manager, and launched an AI-driven product from 0 to 1 as a founding engineer.
about.p3: Across a B2B SaaS, a wealth-management firm, and an early-stage startup, I've learned to build products that are both well-crafted and genuinely useful — and, just as importantly, to actually ship them.
about.outro: you'll usually find me with a guitar in hand — acoustic or electric — chasing a riff instead of a bug.

contact.title: Let's build something that ships.
contact.body: A project, a question, or just to swap notes on engineering — my inbox is open and I read everything.
